newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia's cenbank buys currency to boost liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Croatia's cenbank buys currency to boost liquidity.

text.p: Croatia's central bank said it bought German marks and dollars from the banking sector on Wednesday to boost its liquidity.
It bought 72 million marks ($40.9 million) at an average 3.5634 kuna per mark and $31.7 million at 6.2623 kuna to the dollar.
The bank will pay kuna to banks on Friday.

Foreign exchange purchases are used as a primary source of money creation in Croatia, which experiences strong foreign inflows during the tourist season each summer. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075 ($ = 1.759 German Marks)
